run_card.hypothesis: KG2-H1 (KG2-MGHV): Uncatalogued Great Basin faults span three complementary physical regimes missed by 1m-LiDAR-only and range-front-only detectors: (1) concave-up piedmont-junction slope breaks and asymmetric scarps across the 24.63% (1,272,913-px) 1m-LiDAR void resolved by seamless 10m USGS 3DEP scarp descriptors + 3m gravity-strike-coherent antislope scarps; (2) low-slope (<=6.5 deg) relief-normalized alluvial piedmont & transtensional step-over splays; and (3) blind geothermal vent upflow conduits marked by shallow hydrothermal magnetite destruction -(RTP - RTP_up250m), Gallardo-Meju gravity-magnetic cross-gradient alignment, 2.5km high-pass clay-cap conductivity, K/Th alteration, and 2m thermal-probe/sinter/geothermometer plumes.
run_card.mechanism: Zero-copy Dual-Partition Stitched Out-of-Fold (EXP-1: 4 Quadrant OOF + 4 Rotated-45deg Diamond OOF) 78-channel calibrated 2-seed HistGradientBoostingClassifier synthesis (with selective non-topographic nuisance residualization, 3-tier relief-conditioned LiDAR-gap log-odds calibration, 8-azimuth ridge sharpening, and visible-catalogue apron quantile debiasing) followed by Two-Regime 300m Submodular CELF dot allocation (68% primary multi-scale 10m/3m/1m scarp & piedmont-junction ridge + 32% concealed hydrothermal magnetite-destruction / cross-gradient / vent conduit, min_spacing=2.8 px, 37,654 binary dots, d_catalogue > 2 px, all-finite float32 -zeros.tif).
run_card.non_fault_mimic_process: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines and fluvial fan terrace risers (mitigated by 3m scarp-strike vs isostatic-gravity fault-strike kinematic coherence and multi-azimuth ridge continuity), conductive saline playas (mitigated by 2.5km local high-pass conductivity residualization), and unfaulted Tertiary felsic tuff / caldera margins (mitigated by basement gradient & strain gating).
